A '''Republic bond''' was a financial instrument that existed at least in the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]]. [[Raith Sienar/Legends|Raith Sienar]] once put some six million [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|Republic credits]] at [[Ke Daiv]]'s disposal, in the form of untraceable Republic bonds. Ke Daiv used the money at Sienar's direction in order to buy a [[Sekotan Personal Starship]].
